references.text: God's command to march around the city once a day for six days, which the Israelites obey here on the second day
The description of the first day when the ark was carried around the city and the people returned to camp, the same pattern repeated here
The preceding verse describing the procession around the city, continuing in this pattern for six days
The seventh day when the pattern changes and they march around the city seven times, in contrast to the previous six days
Hebrews' reference that the walls of Jericho fell by faith after the Israelites had marched around them for seven days
